newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Alabama Housing Finance Authority.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Alabama Housing Finance Authority.

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received by Alabama Housing Finance Authority (the Authority'') for the purchase of the above-described Single Family Mortgage Revenue Bonds of the Authority (the Bonds''), as follows:

The 1997 Series A-1 Bonds, the 1997 Series A-2 Bonds and the 1996 Series A-2 Bonds will be dated the date of initial delivery (expected to be January 27, 1997) and will bear interest from such date. Interest on the Bonds will be payable semi-annually on the first day of April and October commencing April 1, 1997. The Bonds will mature on the dates and in the principal amounts described in the Preliminary Official Statement and in the Notice of Sale.

Bidders may provide that all the Bonds be issued as serial bonds or may provide that any two or more consecutive annual principal amounts within each series of Bonds be combined into one or more term bonds. The Bonds will be prepared and delivered as fully registered book-entry bonds to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, on or about January 27, 1997 as more fully set forth in the Notice of Sale. However, such delivery may take place at such other time and place as may be agreed upon by the Authority with the successful bidder.

The Bonds will be payable solely from certain revenues and properties of the Authority that are more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement of the Authority dated January 6, 1997 pertaining to the Bonds. The Bonds will not constitute a debt, liability or other obligation of the State of Alabama or any political subdivision thereof nor will they constitute a pledge of the full faith and credit or taxing power of the State of Alabama or any political subdivision thereof. The Authority has no taxing power.
The Authority reserves the right (i) to reject any or all proposals to purchase the Bonds and to waive any

irregularity or informality with respect to any proposal, (ii) to postpone the date established for receipt of bids, upon notice via Munifacts, not later than 1:00 p.m., Alabama time, on the day prior to the bid opening, (iii) to modify the principal amortization schedule prior to the time bids are to be received, upon notice via Munifacts, not later than 1:00 p.m., Alabama time, on the day prior to the bid opening, and (iv) to adjust the annual principal maturities
after the receipt and opening of sealed bids, subject t limitations contained in the Notice of Sale.
The Bonds will be subject to optional and special
redemption as described in the Preliminary Official
Each bid must be on the Official Bid Form for the Bonds and must conform to the terms and conditions set forth in the Notice of Sale.

This announcement does not constitute the solicitation of bids to purchase the Bonds. The sale of the Bonds shall be made exclusively pursuant to the terms of the Notice of Sale. Copies of the Notice of Sale, the Official Bid Form and the Preliminary Official Statement will be furnished upon request made to the office of Mr. Robert L. Strickland, Jr., Alabama Housing Finance Authority, 2000 Interstate Park Drive, Suite 408, Montgomery, Alabama 36109, telephone: (334) 244-9200, or Ms. Monika Conley, Public Resources Advisory Group, 40 Rector Street, Suite 1600, New York, New York 10006, telephone: (212) 566-7800.
